Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii financiare
We’re a fast-scaling digital bank on a mission to become the go-to primary bank for millions. We put people first —our customers, our teams, and our communities. Now we’re looking for builders, dreamers, and doers to help us craft best-in-class mobile banking experiences.
 What you’ll do 
 As an Android Engineer, you’ll:
 • Build beautiful, performant, and secure Android apps that our customers love to use every day.
 • Partner with design, product, and backend teams to ship features end-to-end.
 • Champion clean architecture, scalable code, and best practices in Android development.
 • Explore the latest Android tech and bring innovation to our mobile platform.
 • Mentor and uplift teammates—because great products come from great teams.
 What we’re looking for 
 • 4+ years of experience building Android apps at scale.
 • Proficiency in Kotlin (bonus if you’ve also worked with Java).
 • Solid grasp of Android SDK, Jetpack, Coroutines, and modern architecture patterns (MVVM, MVI, etc.).
 • Experience integrating with APIs and working in CI/CD-driven environments.
 • A product mindset—you care as much about the “why” as the “how.”
 Why you’ll love it here 
 • Impact at scale: Your work will power the everyday financial lives of thousands (and soon millions).
 • People-first culture: We win together, grow together, and celebrate every milestone.
 • Fast-moving environment: Ship, learn, improve, repeat. No red tape, just real impact.
 • Growth opportunities: Be part of shaping the future of digital banking and your own career.
